official.deadline_central_display: 31 October 2026 (postgraduate); the undergraduate deadline was 30 September 2026
official.deadline_note: Undergraduate applications for the 2027 intake are closed (deadline was 30 September 2026); postgraduate applications remain open until 31 October 2026. Applicants should check with the relevant UCT faculty for programme-specific requirements and deadlines.
official.status_note: Applications are open for the 2027 intake; undergraduate applications closed on 30 September 2026 and postgraduate applications remain open, closing 31 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: UCT states the programme provides comprehensive financial support covering tuition fees for the chosen programme of study, a laptop, accommodation on UCT's campuses, living expenses, medical aid, a study visa (where applicable) and annual travel to and from UCT.
benefits: Comprehensive financial support covering tuition fees for the chosen programme of study, a laptop, accommodation on UCT's campuses, living expenses, medical aid, a study visa (where applicable) and annual travel to and from UCT

requirements: Submit the admission application to the University of Cape Town
Submit the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application separately
Meet the requirements of the chosen UCT faculty - applicants should check with the relevant faculty for programme-specific requirements and deadlines
documents: UCT admission application and supporting academic documents
Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application form
Academic transcripts and prior study records as required by the chosen UCT faculty
selection_criteria: Academically talented with a demonstrated commitment to learning and a drive to complete your education
Limited in your ability to access education owing to significant financial barriers
Committed to investing in your community through the skills and knowledge acquired
A future leader committed to ethical transformation and making a positive contribution to your community and broader society
coverage: Tuition fees for the chosen programme of study
Annual travel to and from UCT
application_method: STEP 1 - review UCT's website for information about study options at https://uct.ac.za/applicants-and-students
STEP 2 - submit the application to the University of Cape Town at applyonline.uct.ac.za
STEP 3 - submit the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application at https://uct.ac.za/mastercardfdn
official.application_route: Two separate submissions: a UCT admission application first, then the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application
official.study_mode: Full time; the programme does not cover part-time studies, or qualifications by research only (Master's by dissertation or PhD)
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of an African country, including South Africa
official.international_eligibility: Open to citizens of any African country, including students from outside South Africa; UCT encourages applications from young women, people living with disabilities, refugees and forcibly displaced youth
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Available across UCT's six faculties - Commerce, Engineering and the Built Environment, Health Sciences, Humanities, Law and Science; excludes part-time study and research-only qualifications
official.duration: The full period of the UCT programme of study; renewable annually subject to satisfactory academic performance and personal conduct and participation in the programme's development activities
official.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town, delivered in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, provides scholarships and comprehensive support to academically talented young people who face significant social and economic barriers to accessing higher education, enabling them to pursue a first bachelor's degree or an eligible taught postgraduate qualification at UCT.
official.program_type: Foundation-funded need-based scholarship administered by a university

applicant_utility.summary: The award is a package rather than a cheque: tuition, a laptop, campus accommodation, living expenses, medical aid, a study visa and annual flights all sit inside it, so the money question is settled - what is not settled is admission. You must first hold a UCT offer, which means your faculty's own application deadline can bind you harder than the programme's 31 October date.
applicant_utility.best_fit: African students who are financially excluded from higher education - first-degree applicants, young women, people living with disabilities, and refugees or forcibly displaced youth.
application_readiness_checklist: Pick the exact qualification first: only first bachelor's degrees, Faculty of Health Sciences postgraduate diplomas, honours degrees and coursework master's programmes qualify
Check your target faculty's own application deadline, which may fall before the programme deadline
Prepare and submit the UCT admission application before the Mastercard Foundation form, since an offer of admission is a precondition
Be ready to evidence the social and economic barriers you face - it is an explicit selection criterion
Note that research-only qualifications (Master's by dissertation, PhD) and part-time study are excluded
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the scholarship application alone is enough without a separate UCT admission application
Targeting a research-only qualification or part-time study, neither of which is covered
Missing the faculty's own deadline while focusing on the programme's 31 October date
Under-evidencing the social and economic barriers criterion, which carries equal weight with academic talent
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The package covers tuition, a laptop, campus accommodation, living expenses, medical aid, a study visa and annual travel; anything outside that list - family costs, spending beyond the living allowance - remains yours.
document_audit: Admissions and funding are two separate applications; one does not trigger the other automatically
Faculty-specific documents apply, so the file for a coursework master's differs from an honours application
alerts: Undergraduate applications for the 2027 intake closed on 30 September 2026; only the postgraduate route is still open
Acceptance of admission at UCT alone does not guarantee selection, and only admitted students can be awarded
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to UCT through the online admissions system, then submit the separate Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program application; selection follows the admission offer.
